entries.title: Isaiah 54:1
segments: ¶Sing, O barren, thou [that] didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou [that] didst not travail with child: for more [are] the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.

words.text: , thou [that] didst not travail with child

entries.title: Isaiah 54:2
segments: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

entries.title: Isaiah 54:3
segments: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:4
segments: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

words.text: not; for thou shalt not be ashamed
; for thou shalt not be put to shame

entries.title: Isaiah 54:5
segments: For thy Maker [is] thine husband; the LORD of hosts [is] his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:6
segments: ¶For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:7
segments: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:8
segments: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:9
segments: For this [is as] the waters of Noah unto me: for [as] I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

words.text: unto me: for [as] I have sworn
that I would not be wroth

entries.title: Isaiah 54:10
segments: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

words.text: from thee, neither shall the covenant

entries.title: Isaiah 54:11
segments: ¶O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, [and] not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:12
segments: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:13
segments: And all thy children [shall be] taught of the LORD; and great [shall be] the peace of thy children.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:14
segments: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

words.text: ; for it shall not come near

entries.title: Isaiah 54:15
segments: Behold, they shall surely gather together, [but] not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:16
segments: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:17
segments: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue [that] shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This [is] the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness [is] of me, saith the LORD.
